atoms.a: Joana and Leo are siblings, and together they get an allowance of £24 per week. How much do they get each if the money is split evenly?
atoms.sound: Joana and Leo are siblings, and together they get an allowance of 24 pounds per week. How much do they get each if the money is split evenly?

atoms.a: At a school, there are 70 pupils and 10 teachers. How many pupils are there for each teacher?
A total of 25 people live in 5 houses. If an equal number of people live in each house, how many people live in one house?
14 rabbits live in the field. Half are female and half are male. How many of the rabbits are male rabbits?
The cost of the dinner was £110. There were 10 people at the dinner, and they split the cost evenly. How much did one person have to pay?
